ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity (white) pixels covering the lateral lobes and 25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in a central wedge-shaped region and along the trailing edge periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two dominant high-intensity white blobs occupy the left and right lobes. A central low-intensity black wedge extends from the base toward the median notch, featuring 'feathered' edges. Sparse low-intensity focal spots are scattered across the mid-sections of both white lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a base angle estimated at 50 degrees and a vertical depth extending approximately 12% into the fluke's total height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency serrations with variable amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels. Multiple distinct V-shaped notches are visible, notably a deep indentation on the upper right trailing edge and several jagged peaks on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a complex non-linear path with overall concavity from the distal tips toward the median notch, while the leading edge (partially visible) exhibits a smooth convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-relief pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonies are located at both the extreme left and right tips. Several small, circular dark focal points are visible on the inner right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions (parallel rake marks) are visible against the low-intensity black central region, oriented primarily on a horizontal-to-diagonal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at both distal fluke tips; multiple irregular trailing edge notches indicating previous tissue loss; prominent linear scarring/rake marks in the central dark zone.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellow-toned discoloration or organic growth visible on the upper-outer corner of the right lobe; unique splattered transition pattern between the central black and lateral white pigmentation zones.
